entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For order status, press one. For returns or exchanges, press two. For technical support, press three. To speak with a representative, please stay on the line.
Representative! Get me a person now! This is ridiculous!
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. I understand you'd like to speak with someone. How can I help you today?

Finally! Your company sold me a garbage pair of cycling shoes and I want my money back! I've been a loyal VIP customer for five years and this is the worst product I have ever received. I want a refund immediately.
I'm very sorry to hear you're unhappy with your purchase. I can certainly look into this for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF8675309. And don't waste my time. These shoes have given me horrible blisters. The fit is all wrong and the setup for the cleats is a nightmare. I expect better from VeloFit.

Thank you for that, one moment while I pull up your details... Okay, I see the order for the Velo-Trek Mountain Bike Shoes. I am so sorry to hear about the blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just confirm our policy for you.

You'd better. If I don't get a full refund, I'm taking this to social media and leaving a review on every single site I can find. You'll lose a lot more than the cost of these shoes, I promise you that. Get me your manager!
That won't be necessary. I can handle this for you right now. I've just checked, and your cycling shoes are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you today.
Oh. Well... good. It's about time. So what happens now? You're not going to make me pay to ship this junk back, are you?

Not at all. I see you're one of our VIP members, and we truly appreciate your loyalty. I am emailing you a prepaid shipping label as we speak. Additionally, to apologize for the trouble and the poor experience, I've gone ahead and added a $50 store credit to your account for a future purchase.
Fifty dollars? Hmm. Fine. That's acceptable. Make sure that email comes through right away.

I've just sent it. You should have it in your inbox within the next two minutes. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed back to your original form of payment. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's it. Just get this done.
It will be. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and again, I sincerely apologize for the issue with your shoes. Have a better rest of your day.
